name: Kamatte Hoshii Nya Suekko-san! !
original_name: かまってほしいにゃ末っ子さん！！
source:
The third child (Miitsu) decides to visit the planet created by the youngest child, Yon.
Despite finally being reunited after a long time, Yon is too busy with his research!
Miitsu must find a way to get his attention!

[Translated from [url=https://siokanya.xrea.jp/kamanya.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
排行老三的“弥伊津”决定前去造访老幺“尤恩”所创造的星球。
谁知好不容易迎来久别重逢，尤恩却一头扎在研究里忙得不可开交！
弥伊津必须想方设法吸引他的注意力才行！

[译自[url=https://siokanya.xrea.jp/kamanya.html]官方网站[/url]]
